title: 日本で暮らす多様な人々
subject: 日本で暮らす多様な人々
subject_en: A diverse faceless resident cast living in Japan, varied skin tones, varied hair textures, modest everyday clothing in muted blue, green, beige and gray, rounded flat shapes, no facial features, no stereotypes, no real person or existing character. Always the same face, hairstyle and outfit.
